title: Feature tokens, units, governed datasets, OOD classes and constraints (NF-1T)
note: NT1-NT20: a feature's identity or dimension dropped, NaN or infinity or a missing value turned into a number, a domain or a dimension not enforced, a unit not converted, statistics from beyond the training split, splits that depend on order, leakage checks disabled, the OOD and constraint findings silenced.

mutations.name: NT1_feature_identity_dropped
mutations.rationale: every feature shares one identity

mutations.name: NT2_dimension_dropped
mutations.rationale: 0.01 K and 0.01 Pa become the same token

mutations.name: NT3_nan_accepted
mutations.rationale: NaN read as a number

mutations.name: NT4_infinity_accepted
mutations.rationale: infinity read as a number

mutations.name: NT5_required_value_may_be_missing
mutations.rationale: a required feature silently absent

mutations.name: NT6_lower_domain_unchecked
mutations.find: if spec.lower is not None and x < spec.lower or \
mutations.rationale: a value below the physical domain accepted

mutations.name: NT7_unit_not_converted
mutations.rationale: a value given in another unit of the same dimension is not converted: 10 mK is read as 10 K

mutations.name: NT8_dimension_mismatch_accepted
mutations.rationale: a pressure accepted for a temperature

mutations.name: NT9_log_magnitude_wrong_base
mutations.rationale: the magnitude channel in the wrong base

mutations.name: NT10_exact_zero_not_flagged
mutations.find: vals[i, j] = (z, sign, log_mag, 1.0 if si == 0 else 0.0)
mutations.rationale: an exact zero indistinguishable from a tiny value

mutations.name: NT11_statistics_from_every_split
mutations.rationale: normalisation fitted on test and OOD data too

mutations.name: NT12_split_ignores_the_family
mutations.rationale: every sample lands in one split

mutations.name: NT13_split_crossing_unchecked
mutations.find: if k in seen and seen[k][0] != split:
mutations.rationale: duplicates across splits go unreported

mutations.name: NT14_digest_binds_ids_only
mutations.rationale: a changed value keeps the dataset digest

mutations.name: NT15_target_copy_unchecked
mutations.replace: if not samples and all(s.inputs[f] == s.targets[t]
mutations.rationale: a feature that copies a target goes unreported

mutations.name: NT16_extrapolation_not_reported
mutations.rationale: outside the training range reported as in distribution

mutations.name: NT17_violation_not_recorded
mutations.rationale: a violated constraint counted as held

mutations.name: NT18_feature_target_overlap_accepted
mutations.rationale: a target allowed as its own input

mutations.name: NT19_unknown_unit_guessed
mutations.rationale: an unreadable unit guessed dimensionless

mutations.name: NT20_missing_value_carries_number
mutations.replace:
valid[i, j] = missing
                vals[i, j] = (1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0)
                continue
mutations.rationale: an absent value encoded as if measured
